query: What is the complexity of QuickSort?
generated_response:
QuickSort has an average time complexity of O(n log n) in its worst-case scenario and can be up to O(n^2) in the worst case due to the worst pivot choice.

```python
# QuickSort function implementation
def quicksort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
    left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
    middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
    return quicksort(left) + middle + quicksort(right)
```

This function takes an array `arr` as input and returns a sorted version of the array using QuickSort. The main idea is to partition the array into three parts: elements less than the pivot, elements equal to the pivot, and elements greater than the pivot. It then recursively sorts these partitions.
